name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed the CopilotKit packages, and created the API route with the BuiltInAgent. The copilot endpoint demonstrably works: `curl http://localhost:3000/api/copilotkit/info` returned valid JSON (`{"version":"1.69.3","agents":{"default":{"name":"default","className":"BuiltInAgent"...}}`), confirming the runtime is serving. However, the frontend compilation repeatedly crashed the dev server and `npm run build` was killed by the OOM killer (exit 137) because the sandbox has only ~2 GB RAM and no swap, making it impossible to compile the React components with CopilotKit providers. I had to deviate from the docs by stripping the frontend CopilotKit wrapper just to keep the API endpoint alive for verification.
